title: Finish an independent Engineering Graph branch under failurePolicy continue
task: Engineering Graph control plane: a bounded wait deadline fails one branch and skips its dependent, while the independent Agent branch must still run to completion under failurePolicy "continue".

nodes.task: `npm test` fails in this project. `titleCase` in src/titlecase.js only capitalises the first character of the whole string. Fix src/titlecase.js so every whitespace-separated word starts with an uppercase letter and the rest of each word is lowercase, and an empty string is returned unchanged. Do NOT edit anything under test/. Run `npm test` to verify.

checks.pattern: lowercases the rest of each word

notes: The expected terminal status is "failed" on purpose: one branch fails, so the run is a failure even though the other branch succeeded. The deterministic failure is a wait node with an expiresAt in the past, which core turns into a bounded zero-attempt failure without a provider call. verify-graph.mjs pins the whole matrix from the checkpoint — failed source, skipped dependent, passed independent branch — which is what separates "continue" from "stop".
